scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "yarn workspace @compiler/backend dev" "yarn workspace @compiler/frontend start"
scripts.build: yarn workspace @compiler/backend build && yarn workspace @compiler/frontend build
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @compiler/shared typecheck && yarn workspace @compiler/backend typecheck && yarn workspace @compiler/frontend typecheck
scripts.ver:major: git pull && yarn version --major && git push && git push --tags
scripts.ver:minor: git pull && yarn version --minor && git push && git push --tags
scripts.ver:patch: git pull && yarn version --patch && git push && git push --tags
